title: Friend or foe
summary: What you do and what you say decides whose side another colony takes.
text:
Another colony's attitude isn't fixed. It moves with how you deal with them.

- **Attacking** them makes enemies. With units selected, tapping a neutral colony's unit or building orders an attack, and that turns them hostile. Your units won't attack an ally
- **Story choices** matter most: what you tell them, what you do for them, and what you do to them
- What you do in one place can be remembered in another

An ally can turn the hardest fight. An enemy you made in a hurry may be one you needed later. When in doubt, hold your fire and talk.
